title: Data Storytelling for Business – Online Course Description

en: Brightpath Learning Ltd. is pleased to present Data Storytelling for Business, a fully online course designed for professionals who want to turn complex figures into clear, persuasive presentations. The course is led by Dr. Elena Marsh, who has more than 15 years of experience in business analytics.

The programme consists of 12 modules delivered over 8 weeks, with a total of 36 hours of video lessons, practical exercises and live question-and-answer sessions. Each module ends with a short assessment, and participants who complete at least 80% of the assessments receive a certificate of completion.
The next cohort begins on April 6, 2026, and enrolment closes on March 27, 2026. Places are limited to 150 participants per cohort to ensure that every learner receives personal feedback.
The standard price of the course is €490.00 per participant, including VAT. Learners who register before March 13, 2026 benefit from an early-bird discount of 15%.

Companies may purchase a team licence for up to 5 employees at a price of €1,950.00. Our partner Northfield Analytics provides all course participants with free access to its visualisation software for 6 months.

If you are not satisfied, you may request a full refund within 14 days of the course start date, provided that you have completed no more than 2 modules. All course materials remain available on the platform for 12 months after the final module.
